relevant_laws.quote: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway, unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].
relevant_laws.notes: The cell has a traffic light and a possible pedestrian road-entry maneuver; activation remains source-observed.
